top_stories.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., according to an official post on its website. No further details about the deal's terms or strategic rationale are provided in the announcement. This continues OpenAI's pattern of acquisitions to expand its capabilities.

top_stories.title: Geoffrey Hinton: it might turn out we were better off without AI
top_stories.summary: AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton has suggested that humanity might ultimately have been better off without artificial intelligence, in comments reported by The Guardian. Hinton, who shared the Nobel Prize in Physics for his foundational work on neural networks, has been a prominent voice raising concerns about AI safety risks since leaving Google. The remarks underscore his ongoing pessimism about the trajectory of AI development.

top_stories.title: UK Officials Said AI Would Add £400 Billion to the Economy. That Figure Mainly Came From Google
top_stories.summary: Wired reports that a widely cited UK government claim that AI would add £400 billion to the economy was largely derived from figures provided by Google, raising questions about the independence of economic projections used to shape AI policy. The story highlights how tech industry data can flow directly into official government messaging without independent verification. This has implications for how AI governance and regulatory decisions are being made.

top_stories.title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
top_stories.summary: OpenAI is rolling out the ability for ChatGPT to generate animated GIFs, expanding the platform's image generation capabilities. The feature is part of ongoing updates to ChatGPT's creative tools, building on the previously released Images 2.6 model. This represents a further step in OpenAI's push to make generative AI outputs more dynamic and multimedia-capable.

top_stories.title: Uber only fulfilled 4 rides from AI agents last quarter
top_stories.summary: Uber revealed in its Q3 earnings that AI agents completed just four rides on its platform during the quarter, illustrating the still-nascent state of autonomous AI agent commerce. The company is nonetheless watching the space closely, concerned about the long-term risk of AI agents disintermediating its platform. The figure offers a rare concrete data point on the real-world traction of agentic AI in consumer services.

further_links.title: Hugging Face's CEO Says His P(Doom) Is 'Close to Zero' [Metered]
further_links.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue tells Wired he is highly optimistic about AI's future, putting his probability of catastrophic AI outcomes at near zero.

further_links.title: Google hasn't figured out how to make AI pay like its search engine
further_links.summary: An analysis of Alphabet's Q3 earnings finds that Google's AI Overviews and AI-driven search products have not yet translated into revenue gains comparable to its legacy search business.

further_links.title: Google Is Forcing AI Overviews in Classrooms. Schools Are Searching for a Way Out [Metered]
further_links.summary: Wired reports that Google's rollout of AI Overviews in Workspace for Education is proving controversial, with many schools seeking ways to disable the feature amid concerns about accuracy and academic integrity.

further_links.title: YC's Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
further_links.summary: Y Combinator president Garry Tan says he spends as much as $200,000 annually on AI agent compute, underscoring heavy adoption of agentic AI tools among tech leaders.

further_links.title: Sam Altman addresses RAM comments: People should 'put as much as they want in their computers'
further_links.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman walked back earlier remarks about RAM requirements for AI, saying people should feel free to put as much memory in their computers as they like.

further_links.title: AI data centers comprehensively defeated at US midterm elections
further_links.summary: Tom's Hardware reports that of 45 ballot measures related to AI data center developments put before US voters in the midterms, the overwhelming majority were rejected.

further_links.title: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput. [Metered]
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines how Texas's rapid expansion as a hub for AI data centers may be stalling amid political, infrastructure, and energy challenges.

further_links.title: Securing the agentic enterprise with data lineage [Metered]
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review explores how data lineage tools are being proposed as a key mechanism to maintain security and accountability as enterprises deploy increasingly autonomous AI agents.

further_links.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T's smart security system
further_links.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant has been integrated into AT&T's connected home security platform, expanding its reach into consumer smart home devices.

further_links.title: AI is forcing us to pay off 40 years of technical debt
further_links.summary: IEEE Spectrum argues that the rapid adoption of AI in cybersecurity is exposing and accelerating the reckoning with decades of accumulated software vulnerabilities and legacy system weaknesses.
